subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth connection diagnostics may the Control UI expose and make copyable without weakening auth, device identity, endpoint, and privacy boundaries?
rationale: The valuable part of the feature is before a trusted session exists, so automation should not choose disclosure, redaction, retention, and copy/export policy on its own.

options.title: Sanitized Client Diagnostics
options.body: Expose only client-side timing phases, close codes, redacted error codes/details, and copy support before auth; keep gateway log tails post-auth.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep pre-auth UI to categorized failure guidance and expose richer gateway logs only after operator.read is available.

options.title: Consent-Based Support Export
options.body: Design a broader export that combines redacted client diagnostics with authenticated gateway logs after connection succeeds.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Client Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose only client-side timing phases, close codes, redacted error codes/details, and copy support before auth; keep gateway log tails post-auth.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the login-gate, reconnect, and auth-adjacent Control UI recovery surfaces where this decision would land.
